description.value: Marble House Eatery is a Chinese restaurant on the second floor of Crystal Mall in Burnaby, described on its own site as one of the city's most iconic Chinese restaurants. It offers three distinct culinary formats under one roof: traditional dim sum at lunch, all-you-can-eat mini hotpot at dinner, and BBQ available throughout the day. A touring cyclist looking for a hearty, varied Chinese meal along the Kingsway corridor will find a full-service restaurant with a lively neighbourhood atmosphere.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (3 spaces) at 18m; stands (3 spaces) at 30m; stands (3 spaces) at 56m; rack (6 spaces) at 63m; stands (5 spaces) at 83m. Total: 20 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the OSM name, phone number (604-336-9188), and address (#2228-4500 Kingsway, Burnaby, BC V5H 2A9). The about page establishes this is a sit-down Chinese restaurant inside Crystal Mall offering dim sum, hotpot, and BBQ; the contact page explicitly mentions pickup orders ('To make a reservation, or order a pick-up, please feel free to call us'), confirming takeout. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, charging, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in the OSM tags.
concerns: Restaurant is on Floor 2 of Crystal Mall — bike parking would be at the mall exterior, not directly at the venue.

Website front-page header shows 'Monday – Sunday: 9:00 – 22:00' but the contact subpage shows a different schedule (Wed from 16:00, Fri-Sat until 23:00); hours data on the site appears inconsistent and may be out of date.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a functioning website, confirmed address, and multiple cuisine offerings; a legitimate stop for touring cyclists along Kingsway.

wow_evidence: dim sum at lunch, all-you-can-eat mini hotpot at dinner, and BBQ available throughout the day
